title: Detection
description: Single detection object from any model (YOLO, COCO, custom).

center_x.description: X coordinate of center (pixels or normalized 0-1).

center_y.description: Y coordinate of center (pixels or normalized 0-1).

area_ratio.description: Ratio of bbox area to image area, in [0, 1]. Optional.

source.description: Source of detection (e.g. yolo, hsv-marker) for debug. Optional.
